pages.title: The Full Picture
pages.text: Every time you eat, Nourished calculates a single $(thing)nutrition multiplier$() that determines how much that meal actually fills your bars.$(br2)It is not one system — it is $(bold)four, blended together$():$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Item memory$() — how often you ate this specific food$(li)$(thing)Category memory$() — how saturated that food group is$(li)$(thing)Family memory$() — how often you ate similar foods$(li)$(thing)Novelty bonus$() — reward for eating something genuinely new

pages.title: How They Blend
pages.text: Item memory carries the most weight. Category and family memory only matter when you have been over-relying on a group — their influence grows the more saturated they become.$(br2)Novelty is applied $(bold)last$() as a multiplier on top of everything else. A food you have never eaten gets a $(c:#52c252)25% bonus$() no matter what the other signals say.

pages.title: Reading the Number
pages.text: The $(thing)Diversity score$() on food tooltips is this final blended multiplier:$(br2)$(c:#52c252)$(bold)Above 1.0$()$() — novelty bonus is active.$(br2)$(c:#e05252)$(bold)Below 1.0$()$() — diminishing returns have kicked in.$(br2)The floor is $(bold)15%$() — you always get at least 15% of a food's nutrition no matter how much you spam it.$(br2)$(italic)Variety is rewarded. You are never completely punished for eating.$()
